content.en: Researchers are exploring how deep learning techniques can improve prediction and decision making in smart health services by applying them to sensed data. They are also investigating the use of edge computing and cloud platforms to provide effective and trustworthy monitoring of patients in healthcare systems, using algorithms like the ETS-DNN model with Hybrid Modified Water Wave Optimization technique. Additionally, they are exploring the integration of deep learning algorithms and IoT for effective disease diagnosis in smart healthcare systems, using wearable devices and isolation forest for outlier detection.
content.da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan deep learning-teknikker kan forbedre prediktion og beslutningstagning i smarte sundhedstjenester ved at anvende dem på sensed data. De undersøger også brugen af edge computing og cloud-platforme til at levere effektiv og pålidelig overvågning af patienter i sundhedssystemer ved hjælp af algoritmer som ETS-DNN-modellen med Hybrid Modified Water Wave Optimization-teknikken. Derudover udforsker de integrationen af deep learning-algoritmer og IoT til effektiv sygdomsdiagnose i smarte sundhedssystemer ved at anvende bærbare enheder og isolation forest til outlier detection.

critic.en: You know what this sounds like? An AI fantasy where everything is optimized and trustworthy. But here's my take—I'm skeptical about living in a world where it's all about high-tech gear. Are we really creating better healthcare, or are we just further entrenching a system that sees patients as data points and profits as the ultimate goal?
critic.da: Det er som om, de tror, teknologien kan erstatte menneskets intuition og empati. Hvordan vil de sikre, at disse "smarte løsninger" respekterer patientens privatliv og autonomi?

potential.en: It's truly remarkable how technology is revolutionizing the healthcare industry! The ability to collect and analyze data in real-time using deep learning and IoT devices has the potential to save so many lives. I'm particularly excited about the use of edge computing and cloud platforms to ensure that this data is securely stored and easily accessible to healthcare providers. This breakthrough in integrating smart health solutions with advanced technologies will lead to more precise diagnosis and personalized treatment for patients. Technology is indeed a game-changer in healthcare!
potential.da: Hvorfor er det altid sundhedsdata, der skal retfærdiggøre en ny teknologi? Kan vi ikke bare sige, at det er sejt i sig selv?
